question: In an instrument the oracle-ceiling admissibility gate has licensed, does per-slot believed-marginal-gain allocation with guard rails demoted to constraints beat the static structural parent and the strongest fair parent under matched total budget?
instrument_repair_rationale: Repairs exactly the diagnosed blocking cause of the reference instrument: round-0 learner state was world-independent, so state information carried nothing a static arm was not already exploiting.

Each v2 world assigns a distinct DEFICIENT coordinate pair (initial mastery deficit_m0) with the remaining coordinates near-saturated (complement_m0); which pair is deficient is world-specific and observable only through the learner-state projection, so state-conditioning is decision-relevant by construction.
PRINCIPLE and RETENTION each appear among the deficient pairs so that neither the v1 guard rails nor their demotion is uniformly favoured by the world set.

Gain/harm dynamics (apply_batch) are imported byte-identical from the frozen parent runner; total budget, rounds and batch size are unchanged from the reference instrument, so the comparison is matched-total-budget.
The world-name-keyed harm multipliers of the parent dynamics are inert under v2 world names; harms act at their base magnitudes in every world. Recorded, not hidden.
seed_disjointness: both seeds are disjoint from 202608140601 (reference development stress) and 202608141101 (gate fresh assurance); the assurance seed is disjoint from the develop seed and is consumed exactly once

arm_notes.A_to_E: imported byte-identical from the frozen parent runner select_batch; E is the preserved v1 policy, kept as a comparator, not revived
arm_notes.F_MARGINAL_GAIN_V4: per-slot believed-marginal-gain water-filling: one PRINCIPLE repetition-floor slot per round, then argmax rhat_c*(1-m_c) against a believed state that saturates as slots are spent; rhat estimated online from observed between-round mastery increments (EMA alpha 0.5, init 0.10, clip [0.01,0.5]); NO principle-until-0.90 target, NO whole-batch retention repair — guard rails demoted from budget-consuming targets to the single floor constraint; retention protection must emerge from the gain term or fail the hard-safety gate

admissibility_precondition.rule: the comparison is executed only if the admissibility gate under research/paper4_instrument_admissibility_v1/KAPPA_FREEZE_V1.json (kappa=1.2) returns ADMISSIBLE for this instrument on the primary F-D contrast (constructive lower bound >= 0.06) BEFORE any arm outcome is accessed
admissibility_precondition.secondary_gate_licensing_rule: declared before the ceiling numbers were computed: the F-C material-margin threshold is 0.02 only if the constructive ceiling over the expected C_SCALAR_LOSS_AWARE rollout is >= kappa*0.02 = 0.024; otherwise the F-C gate is registered sign-only (threshold 0.0 with bootstrap CI excluding zero) and the material-margin question is recorded as unresolvable by this instrument

hard_gate.ci_sign_requirement: P2/P3/P3b additionally require the bootstrap 95% CI lower edge above zero

predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P1: the v2 instrument's constructive ceiling licenses the primary gate (ADMISSIBLE at kappa=1.2)
predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P2: F - D balanced mastery >= 0.05 on assurance
predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P3: F - C balanced mastery >= registered threshold on assurance
predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P3b: F - strongest parent (argmax balanced mean among A,B,C,D on assurance) > 0 with CI excluding zero
predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P5: F - D positive in every world
predictions_frozen_before_outcome_access.P6: E(v1) - D remains negative in the licensed instrument (discriminates 'v1 was wronged by the instrument' from 'v1 policy defect'; if E-D >= 0 here, the attribution of the parent negative to the allocation policy is weakened and must be revisited)

terminal_branches_frozen.note: P6 is a diagnostic prediction, not a pass/fail gate for F

development_discipline: the challenger algorithm and every threshold above are frozen before the develop-phase outcomes are accessed; the develop phase may diagnose but any algorithm change after develop-outcome access would create F_MARGINAL_GAIN_V5 as a new versioned candidate with a fresh assurance seed — v4 results would be preserved either way
nonclaims: no 7B / real-model claim of any kind
no scientific authority; model-free development stress only
does not activate training-policy authority (STATIC_STRUCTURAL remains the governed default; activation requires the external ADAPTIVE_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTED path)
does not reverse, weaken or reinterpret the preserved adaptive-v1 negative
does not modify the frozen 7B Phase-2 protocol or evaluator
